summary: Two men in medical distress (high altitude sickness — one with breathing difficulty, one with seizures) at Blanca Falls north of the Blanca Subdivision; AVSAR called out technical climbers and a 4x4 specialist as Costilla County brought both subjects down; both reached Incident Command ~2:44 a.m.
responding_agency: Costilla County SAR / Alamosa Volunteer SAR
notes: AVSAR en-route assist; rescue completed by Costilla County teams.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Blanca Peak)
